purpose: Known-phase connection between fixed-ellipse geometry diagnostics and phase accuracy

cases.mechanism: same ellipse, first15s phase=0.2+0.75*sin(2*pi*0.2*t); then base(t-15)
same base phase and ellipse, center displacement in circle coordinates = 0.3*(t/60)*[0.8,0.6]
same base phase and ellipse, center displacement in circle coordinates = 1.0*(t/60)*[0.8,0.6]

pairing: One standard-normal native-coordinate noise array per seed is shared by all cases and noise scales; C/D use exactly A true phase. No resampling seeds or parameters after results.
synthetic_scope: 100Hz matches calibration point cadence. This does not emulate 2000Hz acquisition, chest mechanics or radar scatterers.
solver: Import synchronized_ellipse_fixed.py without changes; production ellipse_phase uses first30s and original radial RMSE<=0.2 and other guards.
geometry: Import enumerate_fit/transfer_pair from audit_ellipse_applicability.py without changes; save all candidates, both transfer pairs, 6 initial5s block metrics.
phase_alignment: Fit only sign in {-1,+1} and a constant offset by minimum unwrapped calibration MSE over [0,30). Apply same sign/offset through test. No test alignment, slope fitting or detrending.
primary_metrics: test cycle-index transitions including calibration boundary
cycle_definition: cycle index=round((aligned recovered phase - true phase)/(2*pi)); mismatch uses absolute index !=0. This is an operational cycle-scale error and can arise from model error as well as unwrapping. Also compare cumulative-conjugate increments to numpy.unwrap for implementation consistency.
increment_scoring: Only increments with both endpoints in test [30,60); exclude the crossing increment at30s from RMSE, include it for cycle transition catalogue.

phase_quality_reference.meaning: Predeclared engineering diagnostic tolerances, not biological or clinical accuracy guarantees; retain continuous errors

rejected_fit_policy: No production phase on rejection. Separately score unique proper finite rejected ellipse as diagnostic only using same calibration-only alignment, with rejected status retained.
stopping: Run all42 fixed cases once. Inspect false acceptance against phase tolerances and false drift tags in B/D. If geometry cannot separate known conditions, limit metrics to QC and close mechanism attribution. Even separation in simulation does not identify the real-six mechanism.
real_data_access: No real signal or ECG/HR arrays opened. Existing six remain development material; other27 subjects retained. No HR readout modification or training.
